sentences.en: Good evening everyone and thank you for coming to the Soccer Club meeting.
sentences.zh: 晚上好，各位，感谢大家来参加足球俱乐部会议。

sentences.en: It's good to see so many parents and children here tonight, and I know you are looking forward to a great football season.
sentences.zh: 很高兴今晚见到这么多家长和孩子，我知道大家正期待着一个精彩的足球赛季。

sentences.en: Now I'd like to take a few minutes to tell you about some changes to the Soccer Club for the coming season.
sentences.zh: 现在，我想花几分钟时间向大家介绍下赛季足球俱乐部的一些变动。

sentences.en: Now, this season we'll be playing all our matches for both the junior and senior competitions at King's Park, instead of Royal Park, which was used last season.
sentences.zh: 本赛季，我们将把青少年组和成年组的所有比赛场地从上个赛季使用的皇家公园改为国王公园。

sentences.en: Now for meetings, we're going to use the clubhouse in King's Park, and the next meeting will be held in the clubhouse on the 2nd of July.
sentences.zh: 至于会议地点，我们将使用国王公园的俱乐部会所，下次会议将于7月2日在此会所举行。

sentences.en: As usual, we hope to begin the season with a picnic next Saturday at the clubhouse.
sentences.zh: 照例，我们希望在下周六于会所举办一场野餐活动来开启新赛季。

sentences.en: Please try and come to the picnic as it's always good fun.
sentences.zh: 请大家尽量参加这次野餐，因为这总是一次非常愉快的活动。

sentences.en: The last week of the season we usually have a dinner and presentation of prizes to the players, and more information about this will be given to you later in the season.
sentences.zh: 赛季最后一周，我们通常会举办一场晚宴，并向球员们颁发奖品；关于此次活动的更多详情将在赛季后期告知大家。

sentences.en: This season we have more teams than ever.
sentences.zh: 本赛季我们的球队数量比以往任何时候都多。

sentences.en: We hope to have ten teams, instead of five, in the junior competition and they will play on Saturday mornings, beginning at 8.30 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我们希望青少年组能有十支队伍，而不是五支，这些队伍将在每周六上午8:30开始比赛。

sentences.en: Training sessions will be held in King's Park on Wednesday afternoons for the juniors and they will be wearing red shirts again this year.
sentences.zh: 青少年组的训练将在国王公园每周三下午进行，他们今年将继续穿着红色球衣。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts 7. 54 Ag In the senior competition, there'll be four teams, the same as last year, and their games will be played on Saturday afternoons starting at 2.30, no sorry, it will be a 2 o'clock start, and .com the training session for seniors is planned for Sunday afternoons.
sentences.zh: 在成年组比赛中，将有四支队伍，与去年相同；他们的比赛将在每周六下午举行，开赛时间由原定的2:30更正为下午2点；成年组的训练则安排在每周日下午。

sentences.en: Now I'd like to introduce you to the new committee for the Soccer Club for this season.
sentences.zh: 现在，请允许我向大家介绍本季足球俱乐部的新一届委员会成员。

sentences.en: Firstly, let me welcome Robert Young, the new President, who will manage the meetings for the next two years.
sentences.zh: 首先，让我们欢迎新任主席罗伯特·杨先生，他将在未来两年内负责主持各项会议。

sentences.en: Robert's son has been playing football with the club for over five years now, and many thanks to Robert for taking on the job of President.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特的儿子已在本俱乐部踢球五年多，非常感谢罗伯特先生出任主席一职。

sentences.en: Next we have Gina Costello, she's the treasurer, and she will collect the fees from you for the season.
sentences.zh: 接下来是财务主管吉娜·科斯特洛女士，她将负责向各位收取本季会费。

sentences.en: Please try and give Gina your fees as early as possible in the season, as the club needs the money to buy some new equipment.
sentences.zh: 请各位尽早向吉娜缴纳会费，因为俱乐部需要这笔资金购买一些新设备。

sentences.en: Then there's David West who has volunteered to be the club secretary, and one of the many jobs he will have is to send out newsletters to you regularly.
sentences.zh: 然后是自愿担任俱乐部秘书的大卫·韦斯特先生，他众多职责之一便是定期向各位发送通讯简报。

sentences.en: If you have any information that may be useful, please let David know so that it can be included in these newsletters.
sentences.zh: 如果您有任何可能有用的信息，请告知大卫，以便将其纳入这些简报中。

sentences.en: Also I'd like to introduce you to Jason Dokic who is the Head Coach.
sentences.zh: 此外，我还想向大家介绍主教练杰森·多基奇先生。

sentences.en: For all the new members here tonight, this is the third year that Jason has been with us as Head Coach, and we are very lucky to have such an experienced coach and former player at our club.
sentences.zh: 对于今晚在座的新会员，这是杰森担任我们主教练的第三年；我们非常幸运能在俱乐部拥有这样一位经验丰富、且曾是职业球员的教练。

sentences.en: He will continue to supervise the teams, at training sessions and on match days.
sentences.zh: 他将继续在训练课及比赛日监督各支队伍。

sentences.en: Now before we finish and have some refreshments, does anyone have any questions they'd like to ask the new committee?
sentences.zh: 那么，在结束会议并提供茶点之前，各位是否有关于新一届委员会的问题想要提问？
